messages:
josh_acme: Hey -- running a quick load test on our trial account and the dashboard still shows 1,000 trial tokens after ~2k successful requests. Responses look normal, status 200, but balance didn't go down. Anyone seen this?

maria_support: Sorry you're hitting this, we can look. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl or SDK) + the org id and approximate times?

josh_acme: Org: acme-corp-trial, window: 2024-10-03 18:02-18:10 UTC. Sample curl: ```
POST /v1/chat/stream 
Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "gpt-open-1",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],
  "stream": true
}
```
We used the streaming endpoint and a small client that reconnects on network blips. Request IDs in responses look like xreq=acme-req-7a8.

maria_support: Thanks. I checked the ledger for acme-corp-trial across that timespan — I don't see any consumption debit events for token burns. Can you confirm the client sent the streaming finalize message (we expect a terminal event so we can count tokens)?

josh_acme: We rely on the client to send an explicit finalize on close. There were multiple reconnects and at least one aborted connection. Not sure if the finalize always made it.

dana_sre: fyi this pattern matches a known edge case: if a streaming session terminates before the client sends the finalize/close frame, the backend used to drop the session without emitting a finalize event => no token burn. There's an open runtime fix but we rolled it into a later patch.

maria_support: For immediate triage, can you share any X-Request-Id header values from one of the successful 200 responses? That lets us pull the exact trace.

josh_acme: here's one: xreq=acme-req-7a8-20241003T180204Z

maria_support: Pulling trace now... trace shows several short-lived streams and one abrupt connection close at the end. No finalize record. Confirming no debit entries.

ben_billing: If it's confirmed the platform didn't record consumption due to missing finalize, billing can issue a provisional credit to make the customer's UI reflect expected usage while eng fixes root cause. What's the token delta the customer expects?
josh_acme: Roughly 1.8k tokens from that window (we logged ~2k responses, average 0.9k tokens).

maria_support: Ok, I'll open a billing case and provisionally adjust the UI balance so your team can continue testing. I'll also escalate to eng-runtime and attach the trace id.

dana_sre: For the eng issue: reproducer notes: start streaming, then cut client socket before sending finalize. Runtime returns 200 but never records finalize; repro on linux client with reconnects. Proposed permanent fix: server-side auto-finalize after a short inactivity window and add server-side detection for abrupt disconnects to emit a finalize with best-effort token accounting. I'll add a flag to force-finalize in the runtime while we patch.

maria_support: Filed INC-2024-8921 for engineering with priority P2 and attached logs/traces (trace: acme-req-7a8-20241003T180204Z). Also opened BILL-1142 for provisional credit of 2000 tokens pending root cause.

ben_billing: Billing note: we will issue the provisional 2000-token credit to org acme-corp-trial and flag for reconciliation once eng confirms the bug and persistent fix. Customer won't be charged.

josh_acme: Thanks, appreciate the quick action. Any ETA on code fix or workaround?

dana_sre: Short-term workaround: add client-side ensure-finalize logic on disconnect and retry finalize until ack. We're also going to backport a runtime guard that auto-finalizes after 15s of no activity. ETA for patch to canary: 48 hours. Full rollout: 7 days.

maria_support: I've updated the customer and sent the provisional credit. @josh_acme please confirm the dashboard reflects the new balance in ~5 min and ping if not.

josh_acme: Dashboard shows  -2000 applied, balance now 0. Thank you! :tada:

maria_support: Marking this thread as escalated -> eng-runtime + billing. I'll follow up when we have the patch PR and release notes.

deploy-bot: Deploy v1.12.7 -> runtime-service started at 2024-10-03T19:00:00Z (no changes to finalize flow in this deploy).

dana_sre: Noted; that deploy didn't include the guard. Will target the canary tomorrow night.

maria_support: Closing support side for now; re-open if you see additional imbalance. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
